name: Clonidine
executiveSummary: Central α2 agonist. Adult HTN PO: **0.1 mg every 12 h**, usual titration **0.2–0.6 mg/day**. ICU sedation: **0.2–2 µg/kg/h** IV. Pediatric crisis: **2–6 µg/kg** IV (max **300 µg**). Do not stop abruptly.
indications:
## Indications

- Hypertension (PO; patches in some countries).
- Adjunctive sedation/analgesia and opioid withdrawal prevention/treatment in ICU.
- Selected hypertensive crisis (PO/IV by availability).

## Precautions

- Bradycardia, sedation, dry mouth. Adjust if GFR very low.
- **Hypertensive rebound** if abrupt stop after prolonged use — wean over days.
- Monitor BP and HR.

> Local ampoules often **150 µg/mL**.

adulto.presentation: Tabs 0.1–0.15 mg; ampoule 150 µg/mL; TTS patch by country.
adulto.dose: HTN PO: start **0.1 mg every 12 h**; usual titration **0.2–0.6 mg/day** (usual max **2.4 mg/day**). Urgency PO: **0.1–0.2 mg**, repeat by response. Sedation/withdrawal IV: **0.2–2 µg/kg/h** (titrate).
adulto.administration: PO. IV: dilute in NS/D5W for pump per card (e.g. 150 µg in 24 mL ≈ 6.25 µg/mL).
adulto.notes: Gradual wean after >2 weeks of use.

pediatrico.dose: HTN crisis (2–18 years): IV **2–6 µg/kg** single dose (max **300 µg**). PO: start **0.5–1 µg/kg every 8 h**, up to max **25 µg/kg/day** (not > **1.2 mg/day**). Sedation/pain/withdrawal: IV start **0.25 µg/kg/h**, increase by 0.1 µg/kg/h (usual effect **1–3 µg/kg/h**); PO **1–3 µg/kg every 8 h** (max **5 µg/kg q8h**).
pediatrico.notes: Adjust if GFR <10 mL/min. No abrupt stop.

stability:
## Stability

- Pump dilution: ~24 h (usual pediatric card).
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Sedation, dry mouth, bradycardia, hypotension, constipation, depression, rebound hypertension on withdrawal.
